en.title: CIS 5.3(l)(ii) refers to 'property related assets, referred to in 3.1(b)' — CIS 3.1 has no paragraph (b)
en.summary: 5.3(l)(ii) requires disclosure of the percentage of net assets that may consist of 'property related assets, referred to in 3.1(b)'. CIS 3.1 is the one-paragraph 'Application' rule of chapter 3 (arrangements not amounting to a CIS) and has no (b); no other rulebook is named. 'Property related assets' is not defined in CIS or Glossary V23.
en.correction: Please replace "3.1(b)" in CIS 5.3(l)(ii) with the intended provision, or define "property related assets"; the target does not follow from the text.
